title: Maximum Number of Ways to Partition an Array
goal: Maximize equal-sum split points after changing at most one value to k.
strategy: Store each split imbalance as twice its prefix sum minus the total. A replacement shifts splits before the changed position one way and splits after it the opposite way, so two frequency maps count all repaired splits.
